items.title: Grok Says Its AI-Generated Version of 'The Odyssey' Is 'Not Historically Accurate'
items.excerpt: Months after Elon Musk declared xAI's model would outclass Christopher Nolan's mythological epic, the bot itself conceded its AI-generated Odyssey adaptation is not historically accurate.

items.title: Zachary Mason Chases the Ghost in the Machine
items.excerpt: Former computer scientist Zachary Mason's speculative collection Fabrications spins stories about relationships between humans and sentient AI designed to serve humanity.

items.title: Deep Unlearning: The Rise of AI and the Radicalization of a Tech Idealist by Timnit Gebru (review)
items.excerpt: PW reviews computer scientist and DAIR founder Timnit Gebru's memoir of her experience inside the AI industry and her turn against it.

items.title: SoA's position on generative AI 'remains unchanged' after backlash to Ethical AI Charter
items.excerpt: Society of Authors CEO Anna Ganley responded to member criticism of the Charter of Ethical AI Use in the Creative Industries (precedes the SoA withdrawal story already published 10-21 — possible storyline dup).

items.title: Is It or Isn't It? How Generative AI is Poisoning the Literary Well For Everyone
items.excerpt: James Folta on Vauhini Vara's Atlantic piece suggesting a Caine Prize-winning story was likely AI-written, the third major literary prize hit by AI accusations this year, and what detector-driven suspicion does to literature.

items.title: Why Are Publishers Suing Big Tech With One Hand and Embracing AI With the Other?
items.excerpt: Maris Kreizman, after an Authors Guild panel on authorship and AI, examines publishers' contradictory stance: suing AI firms over training while signing AI licensing and e-book feature deals.

items.title: How AI Changes the Fundamental Structure of the Classroom—Especially the Segregated Ones
items.excerpt: A book excerpt examining how ChatGPT-era AI tools reshape the structure of American classrooms, with particular effects on segregated schools.

items.title: About that Wired article on book publishers 'quietly' using AI
items.excerpt: Jane Friedman unpacks Wired's report on publishers' AI use, flagging that publishers say the number of authors using LLMs to write their books is much higher than reported (Wired source already published — commentary follow-up).

items.title: Guest Post — When Research Integrity Fails, the Entire System Follows
items.excerpt: Cactus CEO Akhilesh Ayer argues AI tools that generate authentic-looking papers in seconds have amplified research fraud, and that AI-assisted screening plus coordinated action by publishers and institutions is needed.

items.title: The best apps for tracking your reading and discovering new books
items.excerpt: TechCrunch's roundup of Goodreads alternatives, several of which pitch AI-powered recommendations and AI-generated book summaries and thematic analyses.

items.title: AI is Already Everywhere in Publishing (Book Riot podcast)
items.excerpt: Rebecca and Vanessa discuss the so-called exposé of publishing's AI use and yet another prize-winning story that seems to have been written with AI.

items.title: "1시간이면 1권 OK"…AI가 쓴 '딸깍 소설'로 공모전 가도 될까
items.excerpt: AI로 한 시간 만에 쓰는 '딸깍 소설' 투고가 출판사·문학 공모전에 넘쳐나면서, 주최 측과 출판사가 AI 사용 여부 검증에 골머리를 앓고 있다.

items.title: [인터뷰] 책 한 권에서 AI 데이터로…전병욱 멘탯 대표가 그리는 출판업계 AX
items.excerpt: 출판사와 AI 기업 사이 도서 학습 라이선스를 중개하는 멘탯: 계약 출판사 약 95곳, AI 활용 권리 확보 도서 약 3만4000종, 글로벌 AI 기업과 누적 라이선싱 계약 약 150억원.

items.title: 전략집단이음, AI 자율형 '출판 다크팩토리' 실증 완료…11월 1일 상업 가동
items.excerpt: 기획·집필·교정부터 ISBN 발급, 국립중앙도서관 납본, 서점 유통과 정산까지 AI가 자율 수행하는 '출판 다크팩토리'가 11월 1일 상업 가동에 들어간다.

items.title: AI 시대, 웹툰은 어떻게 살아남나…웹툰작가들이 찾은 해법
items.excerpt: 한국만화가협회가 23일 제6차 웹툰포럼을 열고 생성형 AI 시대 웹툰 작가들의 지속 가능한 창작 해법을 논의했다.

items.title: [단독] 앤트로픽 저작권 보상 목록에 '홍길동전' '구운몽', 북한 소설까지 포함
items.excerpt: 앤트로픽 저작권 소송 합의 보상 대상에 '홍길동전'·'구운몽' 등 고전과 북한 소설 '벗'을 포함한 한국 관련 도서 46종이 올라, 영어 번역본 저작권자인 작가·번역가가 보상금을 받게 될 전망.

items.title: [단독] '부커상' 아룬다티 로이 "내 장기 적출당해"…앤트로픽 강력 비판
items.excerpt: 부커상 수상 작가 아룬다티 로이가 자신도 앤트로픽의 무단 학습 피해자라며 "몰래 장기를 적출당한 것과 같다", "인간성에 대한 범죄"라고 비판했다.

items.title: Swedish Writers' Association Accuses Publisher of Distorting Classics with AI
items.excerpt: The Swedish Writers' Association is examining whether publisher Bokum violated the protection of classic works by using AI to rework them (off-list: no on-list outlet covered it).
